Features Designed for Restaurant Operators
Cross-Sell Across Your Restaurant Portfolio
Increase revenue across every restaurant location with AI-powered phone answering and smart reservation management.
Our restaurant voice AI automatically answers calls and suggests available reservations at nearby or sister locations when a guest’s first choice is unavailable.
Comprehensive Reservation Management

Never miss a guest reservation with end-to-end AI reservation management, 24/7. Empower guests to make, change, or cancel reservations, across multiple reservation platforms like OpenTable, Yelp, and SevenRooms, anytime.
User-Friendly Restaurant Prompts

Automatically answer all of your guests’ questions, without having to painstakingly train your AI. Our in-house Conversational Design experts have spent countless hours poring over 17 million+ guest calls to build prompts for guests’ most common questions.
Flexible Call Handling

Let Slang AI handle your calls exactly the way you want them to be handled. Whether it’s setting up call forwarding or telling Slang AI how you want to route VIP calls during or after business hours, we’ve got you covered with easy-to-use call scheduling.
Rich Insights

Don’t let your calls go into a black box. Get the data you need to make smarter decisions, boost revenue across locations, and elevate the guest experience. Access insights on every conversation and reservation—see top caller topics, peak call times, answer rates, guest satisfaction, covers booked, and more. Additionally, view stack-ranked performance across your locations to consistently keep performance high across your portfolio.
Real-Time Alerts
Speed matters. With Slang AI, you’ll get instant alerts for everything from private event inquiries to lost items, delivered straight to your phone, so you’re always on top of guest needs.
Direct SMS
Send real-time SMS messages to guests, including reservation confirmations, ordering links, wine lists, and more.
Easily get guest information, call summaries, call recordings, and transcripts

Access guest information, call summaries, call recordings, and transcripts, in one centralized place. No more guessing what happened on a guest call. Every interaction is fully documented so your staff has the context they need to provide exceptional service.
Use Smart Tags to Prioritize Revenue Opportunities

Slang AI’s proprietary tagging system automatically organizes outstanding guest follow-ups into an easy-to-use Priority Queue so your team focuses on the highest-value opportunities first. Or, sort by tags to hone in on specific use cases in a pinch. Add notes, mark items as resolved, and ensure no potential revenue slips through the cracks.
AI-Powered Texting

Empower your guests to text your restaurant’s phone number and have a full conversation, just as they would over the phone. Guests can book reservations, let you know they’re running late, ask about parking, and everything in between.
